lead: # GRAPH MATERIALIZATION, as a real build-dependency. A package gets exactly ONE build
# script and this crate already has its own, so the `build = "../graph-materialize/
# build.rs"` line the other adopters use is not available here — the shared file has to
# be CALLED instead. build.rs runs it as one more job.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# DuckDB-backed store is on by default. The schema / DDL / connector / coercion
# logic compiles and tests without it (`--no-default-features`), so the bulk of
# the crate is validated without the heavy bundled C++ build.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `cli_main` (the `main` wrapper), `resolve_store_path` (--db→env→default),
# and `emit` (the lean-TSV-vs-JSON dispatch) the `bsc-data` CLI shares with `bsc-plan` / `bsc-logs` / ….
# The DATA GRAPH's global entity store (the-data-graph-a-global-third-pillar) — the same
# verbatim-JSON-per-id store the component + kit libraries use. An entity is a DESCRIPTION, not rows,
# so the global pillar reaches no database at all.
# Shared stdin/print helpers (#2170): `read_stdin_json_one` (trim + parse one JSON object from stdin)
# and `print_json` (compact/pretty stdout) — the rusqlite-free JSON side of the shared SQLite CLI util,
# so `bsc data` shares the exact stdin/print behavior of `bsc plan` / `bsc skill`.
# `bundled` compiles DuckDB from source (mirrors how rusqlite is bundled in
# src-tauri) for cross-platform reliability without a system libduckdb.
# Connector dev-loop transport (#1963): the `bsc data connector probe/try` verbs do authed,
# read-only blocking GETs (`reqwest`) and resolve the source secret from the OS keychain (`keyring`)
# — mirroring src-tauri's versions/features so the CLI authenticates + reads the same secret the app stored.
